external_preprocessing: None; raw Text is retained; standard uncased BERT tokenizer only
checkpoint_selection: Every strict improvement in literal six-class validation macro F1; earliest exact tie wins
early_stopping: Meaningful-improvement clock with min_delta=0.001, separate from literal best checkpoint
weighted_gradient_reduction: Summed weighted CE gradients divided by full accumulation-window sum of target-class weights before clipping and stepping
validation_probability_export: FP32 neural forward without autocast; lossless full-precision arrays and unrounded CSV probabilities
historical_comparison_scope: Exploratory descriptive comparison on identical frozen validation; actual old training recipe is not recovered
reference_recipe_source: Unexecuted/unbound comparison notebook; see reports/BASELINE_COMPARABILITY.md and config/baseline_evidence.json
